_about: ElevenLabs takes for the two bosses' lines (eleven_v4, one take each, 2026-11-07); processed by make_voice.py and make_renegade_voice.py (process stage). Prompt words match en_us.json's cutscene lines.

halvard.voice: Declan Graves - Haunted Rasps and Old World Dread (ElevenLabs voice library)

lines.halvard_intro: [slow, hollow, weary] Another traveller... on my road. [heavy, sorrowful] The oath still holds me here. [low, menacing warning] Turn back, or be buried beside me.
lines.halvard_phase2: [tormented, anguished] The crown calls... [roaring in agony] and I cannot rest!
lines.halvard_death: [dying, fading, finally at peace] The road... is the only home... [last breath] we keep.

renegade.voice: Matthew Schmitz - Ancient Sage Dragon Wizard (ElevenLabs voice library)

lines.renegade_intro: [cold, contemptuous, amused] Idris sent you? Of course he did. [bitter, sneering] He never could bear to look at the dark himself.
lines.renegade_phase2: [manic, ecstatic, shouting] Look up! [unhinged] Watch them go out, one by one!
lines.renegade_death: [dying, breathless, desperate] Tell him... [fading whisper] the chart was true...
